author: Hermes
question: An ideal single-phase transformer has 400 turns on the primary and 200 turns on the secondary. With 230 V (RMS) applied to the primary, what is the no-load secondary voltage?
solution: V2/V1 = N2/N1, so V2 = 230 x 200/400 = 115 V. Topic (transformers) is in the Electrical Machines section of the official GATE 2027 EE syllabus. Source checked: https://gate2027.iitm.ac.in/static/doc/GATE2027_Syllabus/EE_GATE2027_Syllabus.pdf
subject: Electrical Machines
